answer: In a signed attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks: transition mass mixes within well-connected honest regions but leaks slowly across sparse Sybil cuts. Low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S), bounds escape and, via min-cut transitivity, limits a cluster’s stationary influence and aggregate voting weight, even when yarrow, falcon, and mirror identities multiply.
